# `unhex`

<!-- @generated by `cargo xtask docs-sql`; do not edit. -->

Converts hexadecimal `expr` to binary.

**Applies to:** Krishiv 0.2.0 and above. Spark: 3.5 and later.

## Syntax

```text
unhex(expr)
```

## Details

| | |
|---|---|
| Krishiv | Implemented |
| Group | `math_funcs` |
| Kind | scalar (function) |
| Added in Spark | 1.5.0 |
| In Spark profiles | 3.5 and later |
| Arguments | 1 |
| Deterministic | yes |

## Examples

```sql
-- unhex, example 1
> SELECT decode(unhex('537061726B2053514C'), 'UTF-8');
Spark SQL
```

## Version history

- Added in Spark 1.5.0.
- Added in Krishiv 0.2.0.
